subject: Update map and initial parameters of MakeADFun  object without retaping

messages.author: 3115158bfd890d88
messages.subject: Update map and initial parameters of MakeADFun  object without retaping
parts:
Hi All,
 I am doing some cross validation for a linear regression model and wanted to by-pass retaping via the MakeADFun to speed things up. The approach I am thinking Using the DATA_UPDATE function I can set an observation to NA and ignore that observation in the likelihood using an if statement and !R_IsNA. However, I am using a PARAMETER_MATRIX of N(0,1) random effects to account for missing covariate values. What I would like to do is to set values of the map object for the random effects to NA and set the corresponding initial parameters to 0 for observations that I turn off. The I can just re-estimate. Is there a way to update both the map and initial parameters of the MakeADFun object without retaping? Or has anyone found another approach to by-pass retaping.
Thanks,
Grant
